program.name: Dumbbell Strength
program.subject: Strength
program.blurb: Full-body strength with only your dumbbells: no bar, no bell, three different days.
program.about: Everything with a pair of dumbbells. Three full-body days rotate: one leads with squats and presses, one with hinges and rows, one with lunges and overhead work. The kettlebell and the bar stay in the cupboard, which suits a small space or a trip. Abs finish every session. Level II slows every rep down and Level III asks for heavier dumbbells.
program.split: Dumbbell full body A / B / C
